expected_behavior: Closed/full-invoiced PO has zero remaining commitment and does not create RNI.
Zero-budget/zero-hour unused labor code returns not-applicable labor ratios without NaN/Infinity.
Rejected change order is excluded from revised contract and does not require an SOV item.
Pending/non-approved invoice does not reduce commitment, create posted cost, or create AP-missing-posting.
Current positive billing position is overbilling, not underbilling.
Retainage matches SOV retainage within tolerance.
